# Somersault (Carousel 01) — Implementation Plan & Tasks

## Overview

- **New Name:** Somersault
- **ColorLib Source:** Carousel 01 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-01/`)
- **Preview URL:** `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/carousel-01/`
- **Design Category:** Carousel & Slider Showcase / Landing

## Design Tokens & Styling

- **Primary Brand Color:** Indigo/Blue `#4f46e5`
- **Backgrounds:** Clean light `#f9fafb`, white `#ffffff` cards
- **Text:** Dark charcoal `#1f2937`, muted gray `#6b7280`
- **Typography:** Inter (Google Fonts)
- **Buttons:** Rounded-xl primary buttons with hover effects

## Section Outline (1:1 Structure)

1. **Navbar:** Fixed/sticky header with logo, navigation links, mobile menu toggle, and CTA button.
2. **Hero Section:** Interactive carousel slider with multiple slides, titles, CTAs, arrows, and dot pagination.
3. **Showcase Carousel:** Multi-item interactive card slider for featured products/content.
4. **Features Grid:** 3-column icon card grid highlighting key interactive capabilities.
5. **Testimonials / Stats:** Social proof cards and metrics counter.
6. **Newsletter / CTA Banner:** Indigo background banner for user engagement.
7. **Footer:** Multi-column footer with "Made with Component Dock" linking to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Spec validation (`npm run spec:validate`)
- [ ] 100% test coverage (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] Component Dock footer link present and correct
- [ ] CNAME and homepage configured for `somersault.free.componentdock.com`
